budgets.effective_child_deadline: min(remaining complete-suite deadline, remaining collect deadline); never reset by child start or expected crash
budgets.log_limit_semantics: stream-cap individual output and aggregate log; overflow fails, retains a labelled bounded failure prefix, never a truncated success
budgets.on_budget_exhaustion: NOT_ADMITTED; preserve bounded partial evidence and reap owned processes; a future revision requires new preregistration

counting.process_start_formula: 2*(48 positive profiles + 2*57 crash scenarios) + 1 serial batch of 157 target-C controls

crash_oracle_notes.P01: P0 and the parent same-anchor handshake are complete; control temp creation has not begun. Empty control namespace is a rejection with k0.
crash_oracle_notes.P01_P05: read and a separately rebound explicit resume rejection probe must both reject, leave k0, and preserve forensic part/final entries; no auto-cleanup or root regeneration.
crash_oracle_notes.P06_P09: final-only visible state is readable even if prior directory sync is not known; read does not commit. Explicit resume repeats this-call barriers before any unlink.
crash_oracle_notes.P09_vs_P10: P09 is before the first retirement inventory. P10 is after that inventory has fully validated k0 and before seq1 unlink. Both have the same visible files.
crash_oracle_notes.P57: k16 already visible; explicit resume performs zero new unlinks and repeats this-call sync/readback/retained replay before committing.
crash_oracle_notes.process_only: These visible-state oracles describe process SIGKILL on the same live hosted filesystem; they do not assert a post-power-loss disk state.

execution_contract.fixture_cleanup: Only after recording all candidate/recovery observations, remove the test-owned fixture to enforce one active fixture; label cleanup separately, exclude its unlinks from candidate retirement counters, never restore missing original files or use cleanup as a recovery step.

negative_batch_parent_observation_barrie.after_candidate_call: Worker reports case ID, call result, runtime-known/unknown fields and fixture paths, then blocks without cleanup or mutation.
negative_batch_parent_observation_barrie.before_case: New owned fixture and explicit pre-call/post-injection metadata snapshot; one case active.
negative_batch_parent_observation_barrie.continue: Only after parent returns explicit observation-complete acknowledgement may worker clean this test fixture and advance to the next N ID.
negative_batch_parent_observation_barrie.parent: Independently reopen/enumerate permitted fixture paths and verify registered namespace/missing set/side effects using the post-injection pre-call snapshot, not child claimed k.

execution_contract.sanitizer_termination_scope: Normal-exit sanitized transaction/recovery/negative workers run exit-time LSan. SIGKILL victims cannot run exit-time leak checks; no such post-kill leak-check success is claimed.
execution_contract.scientific_repetition_comparison: Compare canonical source identity, fixed FPR1 raw-file digest, original data hashes and semantic case outcomes/state/counts. Actual directory/file dev/ino, fd numbers, PIDs, paths, time/RSS/filesystem observations and the anchor instance containing those host identifiers belong to host attribution and may differ across fresh fixtures/suites. Within each case the original parent-pinned anchor instance must remain fixed and be enforced exactly.

source_ack_observation_contract.forbidden_claim: A parent-carried historical head/tail value is not a post-exec live measurement of a destroyed ring.
source_ack_observation_contract.fresh_recovery: No original source owner, ring memory, producer or ACK capability is passed or reconstructed. Record the parent-held earlier witness with phase=prior_transaction_only; live_source_head_tail=null; require source_owner_received=false, source_owner_reconstructed=false, source_ack_api_calls=0, source_producer_api_calls=0, original_ack_authority=false.
source_ack_observation_contract.receipt_layer: Evidence controls inspect these exact labelled fields; they do not execute source owners.
source_ack_observation_contract.transaction_live_witness: While the real original source owner still exists, snapshot actual ACK/head/tail before and after candidate operations; require unchanged values.

execution_contract.startup_retry_policy: zero automatic retries; any unexplained startup, TSan, ASan, UBSan, QEMU or exec failure fails the suite
execution_contract.target_negative_batch: one real target process runs all 157 target-C IDs serially with a fresh owned fixture for each ID; no target coverage is inferred from Python-only checks
execution_contract.timeout_cleanup: owned process group bounded termination/reap; expected crash SIGKILL is distinct from timeout or sanitizer failure

failure_observation_contract.parent: The parent independently observes fixture namespace after a negative call and checks exact missing sequences and allowed_new_unlinks, including when the child runtime failed before enumeration.
failure_observation_contract.runtime: Before a successful full inventory, failed validation reports observed_prefix_known=false and no fabricated numeric k; complete inventory or own successful unlink may establish explicitly labelled knowledge.
failure_observation_contract.source_owner: Historical parent ACK/head/tail metadata is never a fresh-child live measurement.

interpretation: Metadata-only preregistration; no implementation, compilation, experiment or passing result is supplied.
The 164 N IDs comprise 157 target-C controls, 5 Python receipt controls and 2 Python source-lock controls; these layers are counted separately.
Fifteen E IDs are separate Python artifact-integrity controls completing already-declared evidence requirements; they are not target-C experiments.
Malformed parser/metadata fixtures deliberately reseal only specified outer checks to reach the named inner predicate; they do not establish source authority.
Authority mutations keep the original caller-pinned raw checkpoint digest. On-disk self-hashes cannot grant deletion authority.
All unchanged assertions compare against the post-injection, pre-call snapshot; original pre-injection hashes are also logged to prove the intended mutation occurred.

Failure must preserve already-observed prefix retirement and never invent rollback. The parent independently checks the exact missing set; a failed C call reports only what its completed observations or successful own unlink establish, otherwise observed_prefix_known=false.
The 57 P IDs denote control-flow injection points, not 57 distinct filesystem states or statistically independent observations.
A surviving Python coordinator retains only expected anchor, hashes and metadata. It explicitly starts the same target ELF afresh; ARM uses qemu-arm with the fixed sysroot.
Source stopped/exclusive caller ownership is a precondition. Declaration checks do not prove absence of arbitrary malicious concurrent writers.
Only operation-local observable file inode changes can be rejected; no cross-exec per-file inode continuity is claimed because the external anchor pins directory identities and checkpoint bytes.
No sudo, chown, mount, disk filling, runner-wide fd exhaustion, source mutation or sanitizer downgrade is permitted for these controls.

io_seam_rules.close: For N131/N138 call real close once, then report EIO; fd is already closed, so retrying close is forbidden.
io_seam_rules.eintr: Finite EINTR is retried within unchanged overall deadline; endless EINTR terminates by budget failure, not success.
io_seam_rules.faults_do_not_model_hardware: Injected errno and process kill do not qualify ENOSPC devices, read-only mounts, foreign-owned-file access or physical durability.
io_seam_rules.metadata: N108/N114 mutate only observed st_dev/st_uid respectively after obtaining the real stat; record synthetic status. No privileged filesystem setup.
io_seam_rules.positive_paths: Real kernel open/read/write/linkat/unlinkat/fsync/close and actual directory observation; injection disabled.
io_seam_rules.scope: New A2 wrappers only; each call logs role/phase/matching ordinal, actual syscall completion and injected return separately.
io_seam_rules.short_operations: Ordinary short read/write is retried to completion; negative short cases are partial progress followed by explicit EIO/EOF, not a mandatory failure on all short operations.

mutation_policies.controlled_full_retained_reseal: Start with a legal complete32 fixture at k0; mutate only the named seq17 APX3 flag/frame epoch or FBS1 PCM-FNV field. APX3 is created only by the frozen original writer. Repair affected APX SHA, FBS1 prefix digest, every subsequent full-row prior/selfdigest and canonical record filename, all affected FRM2 member and last-row digests, FRM2 selfdigest/canonical name, FPR1 embedded raw-root digest/selfdigest/canonical name, and a clearly synthetic caller raw-file anchor. Keep retired1..16 rows, logical config, all PCM bytes, and all non-target semantics fixed. This controlled fixture bypasses P0 only to exercise the independent A2 read/resume validator; it is not admitted original-source production data. Original codec decode and a permissive recording visitor replay must succeed. Unmodified A0 bind on the same complete32 mutant must fail; all non-target metadata/CRC/hash/FNV-or-flags checks are separately witnessed so early outer mismatch cannot substitute for the named callback predicate. Never mutate the 81 source inputs.
mutation_policies.controlled_original_metadata: Use original APX3 codec and an isolated record-validator fixture; alter only named FBS1/config semantic field, repair non-target FBS1 prefix digest and canonical record name. The new validator receives original expected source/config/sequence/prior. Also apply the same row/APX mutation to a separate complete32 fixture for unchanged A0 rejection. Root filename or raw anchor mismatch is not accepted as proof of the inner predicate.
mutation_policies.controlled_original_metadata_except_targ: Same as controlled_original_metadata, except N102 deliberately does not repair the target row32 selfdigest; canonical filename is still recomputed from actual full row bytes, and the expected prior/source identity stays original.
mutation_policies.fixed_external_anchor: Preserve original expected raw-file digest and directory/source tuple; do not reseal authority from mutable disk.
mutation_policies.invalid_embedded_frm2_digest: Alter FPR1 offset88 digest; repair FPR1 self/raw digest and canonical name; original embedded FRM2 stays unchanged; synthetic parser anchor reaches the raw-FRM2-digest comparison.
mutation_policies.invalid_fpr1_self: Alter only FPR1 self field; canonical name follows that altered field and synthetic parser anchor matches the actual raw bytes; leave the self inconsistency to be rejected.
mutation_policies.malformed_fpr1_inner: Controlled parser fixture only: mutate the stated field; repair all non-target dependent header/self/raw hashes and canonical FPR1 name; pass its raw digest as an explicitly synthetic parser-test input so the named inner validator executes; never perform retirement.
mutation_policies.original_codec_pcm_mutation: Recreate exactly one retained APX3 using the frozen writer with capture sample0 XOR1 and all other original values; frozen codec must decode/replay the changed stream successfully. Preserve original FBS1 row, filename, A1/FPR1 roots and external anchor, so the actual source digest/FNV binding rejects. No hand-implemented CRC.
mutation_policies.resealed_evidence_copy: Mutate only an isolated evidence copy, recompute all inner SHA256SUMS, keep original bundle untouched; require semantic/source/execution verification rejection.
mutation_policies.synthetic_a2_io_seam: Inject only in new A2 syscall/stat wrapper on the exact phase/path/ordinal. Record before/after syscall execution and errno. Never modify frozen A0/A1/codec or globally interpose libc.

required_trace_verification.actual_layer_counts: Keep target-C, Python N and Python E totals separate. ID existence or Python parser acceptance is not execution evidence.
required_trace_verification.authority_boundary: These consistency checks still rely on an externally trusted CI run and independently retrieved original ZIP; a fully forged self-hashed bundle cannot authenticate itself.
required_trace_verification.build_identity: Exact original source closure, source_commit checkout, compiler/QEMU identity, per-target ELF hash, compile/link flags and target-specific sanitizer environment.
required_trace_verification.exact_sets: Check four targets, two full suites per target, 48 legal profiles, both fixed crash profiles x57 exact P IDs and 157 exact target-C N IDs; no missing, duplicate or substituted IDs.
required_trace_verification.oracle_derivation: Recompute result and counts from raw bounded events, not from an arbitrary receipt summary.
required_trace_verification.original_bundle_first: Verify the unchanged original four-member bundle before any isolated resealed copy.
required_trace_verification.process_identity: Trace every actual child launch and wait; normal exit0 or registered crash -SIGKILL; a marker alone is insufficient.
